paras: Riama colomaromani is a species of lizard in the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species is endemic to Ecuador.
The specific name, colomaromani, is in honor of Ecuadorian herpetologist Luis Aurelio Coloma Román.
R. colomaromani is found in Pichincha Province, Ecuador.
The preferred natural habitat of R. colomaromani is forest, at altitudes of 1,300–2,822 m (4,265–9,259 ft).
